If Object_Id('[dbo].[INFO_Information_KhoaPhong_Doctor_List]', 'P') Is Not Null
	Drop Procedure [dbo].[INFO_Information_KhoaPhong_Doctor_List]
Go

Create Procedure [dbo].[INFO_Information_KhoaPhong_Doctor_List]
(
	@LanguageID Int = 1,
	@NodeID Int,
	@Top Int = 20
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On;

	Select Top (@Top)
		INFO_Information.InformationID,
		INFO_Information.CategoryID,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.TitleEn, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.TitleEn
			Else INFO_Information.Title
		End As Title,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.InformationLinkEn, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.InformationLinkEn
			Else INFO_Information.InformationLink
		End As InformationLink,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.BriefEn, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.BriefEn
			Else INFO_Information.Brief
		End As Brief,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.DescriptionEn, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.DescriptionEn
			Else INFO_Information.Description
		End As Description,
		INFO_Information.Keyword,
		INFO_Information.ThumbImage,
		INFO_Information.ThumbImageSub,
		INFO_Information.ThumbImageList,
		INFO_Information.DisplayFromDate,
		INFO_Information.CreatedDate,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.DoctorEn1, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.DoctorEn1
			Else INFO_Information.DoctorHocVi
		End As DoctorHocVi,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.DoctorEn2, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.DoctorEn2
			Else INFO_Information.DoctorChucVu
		End As DoctorChucVu,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.DoctorEn3, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.DoctorEn3
			Else INFO_Information.DoctorTime
		End As DoctorTime,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.DoctorEn4, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.DoctorEn4
			Else INFO_Information.DoctorRoom
		End As DoctorRoom,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Information.DoctorEn5, '') <> '' Then INFO_Information.DoctorEn5
			Else INFO_Information.DoctorChuyenMon
		End As DoctorChuyenMon,
		N'bac-si' As CategoryLink,
		Case
			When @LanguageID = 2
				And Isnull(INFO_Category.CategoryNameEn, '') <> '' Then INFO_Category.CategoryNameEn
			Else INFO_Category.CategoryName
		End As CategoryName,
		INFO_Category.NodeTree,
		INFO_Information.InformationID_ESS,
		INFO_Information.CheckInfor
	From dbo.INFO_Information
		Inner Join dbo.INFO_Category
			On INFO_Information.CategoryID = INFO_Category.CategoryID
	Where INFO_Information.IsDeleted = 0
		And INFO_Information.IsActived = 1
		And INFO_Information.IsReviewed = 1
		And INFO_Information.IsShowInList = 1
		And INFO_Category.IsDeleted = 0
		And INFO_Category.IsActived = 1
		And INFO_Category.NodeTree Like '%;' + Cast(@NodeID As Varchar(20)) + ';%'
		And (
			INFO_Information.DisplayFromDate Is Null
			Or INFO_Information.DisplayFromDate <= Getdate()
		)
		And (
			INFO_Information.DisplayToDate Is Null
			Or INFO_Information.DisplayToDate >= Getdate()
		)
	Order By
		INFO_Information.SpecialShowID Desc,
		Isnull(INFO_Information.DisplayFromDate, INFO_Information.CreatedDate) Desc,
		INFO_Information.CreatedDate Desc,
		INFO_Information.InformationID Desc
End
Go
